run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T01:10:11Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is firing because frontend-proxy began returning 500s on POST /api/checkout. In the sampled span metrics the frontend-proxy error-span rate sat at 0.01–0.03 spans/s until the 01:20:00Z evaluation and then rose to 0.6–1.73, hitting exactly 1.7333333333333332 at 01:24:00Z (the value in the alert annotation); the only error-bearing frontend-proxy span names are 'ingress' (server) and 'router frontend egress' (client), and its access log shows POST /api/checkout returning 500 'via_upstream'. The downstream operation identified is checkout: frontend's error spans are confined to POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and the client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, and its pod is not ready. The checkout Deployment was rolled to revision 2 at 01:18:49Z with the same image but an env change KAFKA_ADDR from kafka:9092 (revision 1) to kafka:9999; the kafka Service and Endpoints expose only 9092 and 9093, so the new checkout container logs 'Failed to connect to broker kafka:9999: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' from 01:19:21Z, exits with code 2 and is crash-looping. Kafka itself is running, ready, 0 restarts with normal log activity, and all flagd feature flags are 'off', so neither a Kafka outage nor flag-based injection explains the errors.

claims.text: The frontend-proxy error-span rate (traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}, 2m rate) was 0.01–0.03 spans/s through the 01:18:00Z evaluation, jumped to 0.633 at 01:20:00Z and 1.489 at 01:21:00Z, reached exactly 1.7333333333333332 at 01:24:00Z and was 1.30 at 01:26:00Z.

Errors on frontend-proxy exist only on span_name 'ingress' with span_kind SPAN_KIND_SERVER and span_name 'router frontend egress' with span_kind SPAN_KIND_CLIENT, both status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR; their 5m error rates rose together from ~01:20Z and were 0.678 (ingress) and 0.674 (router frontend egress) at 01:23:11Z.

frontend-proxy access logs between 01:26:27Z and 01:27:15Z show requests to frontend being answered 500: lines such as "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream ... frontend 100.96.4.193:8080 (30 of 308 matching lines shown, newest first).

In the 20 minutes ending 01:34:02Z, frontend error spans were concentrated on POST (increase 333.3), POST /api/checkout (333.3), 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' (333.3) and the client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (333.3), plus tcp.connect (36.7); all other frontend span names (GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/*, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, etc.) showed 0.

The checkout Deployment (otel-demo) was updated to revision 2 at 01:18:49Z: new ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b keeps image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout but sets env KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999, whereas revision 1 ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (now scaled to 0) set KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092.

Events for namespace otel-demo record Deployment checkout 'Scaled up replica set checkout-849d65649b from 0 to 1' at 01:18:49Z, ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb 'Deleted pod: checkout-5dccddf8bb-9d9c8' at 01:18:52Z, and Pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout' (Warning) at 01:25:55Z.

Container checkout in pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz repeatedly logs 'Failed to connect to broker kafka:9999: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' and 'kafka: client has run out of available brokers to talk to: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' starting 01:19:21Z, printing its config as kafkaBrokerSvcAddr:kafka:9999 after each failed start.

Pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz is phase Running but Ready=False (reason ContainersNotReady), restartCount 1, with container checkout terminated twice with exitCode 2 (finishedAt 01:22:27Z and 01:25:54Z) and ready=false.

The kafka Service in otel-demo has clusterIP 100.66.162.182 and exposes only ports 9092 and 9093 (targetPorts 9092 and 9093); its Endpoints list a single address (pod kafka-ff7884766-ntckh) with ports plaintext:9092 and controller:9093. Port 9999 does not appear on the Service or its Endpoints.

The causal chain is: checkout Deployment revision 2 points checkout at kafka:9999, which the kafka Service does not expose, so the checkout process cannot build a Kafka producer, terminates with exit code 2 and crash-loops; its PlaceOrder path therefore fails, frontend returns 500 on POST /api/checkout, and frontend-proxy records 500s on its 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' spans, producing the RequestErrorRate alert. The timing is consistent: rollout at 01:18:49Z and first Kafka timeout at 01:19:21Z precede the first error-rate jump at the 01:20:00Z evaluation. The exact error body returned by checkout to frontend was not directly observed.

Kafka is not down: pod kafka-ff7884766-ntckh is Running, Ready, 0 restarts (started 00:45:30Z), and its log at 01:27:03–01:27:09Z shows normal __cluster_metadata-0 segment rolling/snapshot retention activity with no error lines. checkout's timeouts target a port the Service never exposes, so the timeout is not evidence of a Kafka broker failure.

flagd feature-flag fault injection is not the cause: in ConfigMap flagd-config (demo.flagd.json) every flag has defaultVariant "off", including paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, cartFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, and the flagd pod has 0 restarts.

Other services' error rates are not this cause: across the same window ad peaked at 0.0037 spans/s, fraud-detection at 0.0038 and recommendation at 0.0066, with no rise at ~01:19–01:20Z; accounting and payment stayed at 0 error spans/s. Only frontend (up to 2.79/s at 01:23:11Z) and frontend-proxy rose.

frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-n4sbv and frontend-proxy pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-h7j7c are Running, Ready, 0 restarts (started 00:45:30Z); their failures are application-level (500 on the checkout path), not pod-level.

Only the checkout Deployment shows a pod-template rollout in the window: ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b was created 01:18:49Z and the older checkout-5dccddf8bb deleted its pod at 01:18:52Z; no other otel-demo ReplicaSet creation/deletion events appear in the returned event set.

Restore the checkout Kafka address to the port the kafka Service actually exposes (KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092 as in revision 1) or, if 9999 is intended, add that port to the kafka Service and its container, then confirm pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz becomes Ready and POST /api/checkout returns 200 instead of 500.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not present in the queried Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules returned no data for rule_name RequestErrorRate and also an empty rule set for an unfiltered listing, so the rule expression, threshold and evaluation interval behind the alert could not be verified.

The alert's stated firing time (2026-11-18T01:10:11Z) precedes the first observed deviation of the frontend-proxy error-span rate (~01:19–01:20Z) by about 9–10 minutes; the reason for that offset could not be established from the available evidence.
Who or what changed the checkout Deployment to revision 2 (KAFKA_ADDR kafka:9092 -> kafka:9999) at 01:18:49Z is unknown: change-history/audit data is not integrated in this Run.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend or checkout in the queried window (traces_search and traces_search_by_tags error=true both empty) although both services are listed; span-level findings therefore rest on Prometheus span metrics, not on trace graphs, and parent-child edges cannot be asserted.

The checkout container's previous-instance logs were unavailable (no previous terminated container), so the pre-change container's behavior and its last messages were not observed; the old pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9d9c8 was deleted at 01:18:52Z and its logs are unrecoverable.

The exact response body/status checkout returns to frontend for PlaceOrder was not directly observed; the 500 on POST /api/checkout was observed at frontend-proxy, and frontend's error spans on grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder are the closest available signal.

kube-state-metrics deployment readiness queried as kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="otel-demo"} returned no data, so deployment-level ready counts other than from the Kubernetes API pod status are unknown rather than zero.
next_steps: Review who applied checkout Deployment revision 2 (KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999) at 2026-11-18T01:18:49Z via cluster audit logs or GitOps/Helm change history, and whether it was intentional.

After correcting KAFKA_ADDR, verify checkout pod readiness, absence of 'dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout' in its logs, and that POST /api/checkout returns 200 at frontend-proxy before treating the alert as resolved.
Obtain the RequestErrorRate alerting rule definition and evaluation window to reconcile the stated 01:10:11Z firing start with the ~01:19–01:20Z metric onset.

view.series_note: traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans of every operation of the service (internal, client and server spans alike), summed over the labels kept in this query; it is not a count of requests. status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET means the span carried no status; it does not mean the call succeeded.
